# Check for rg availability
if ! hash rg 2>/dev/null && ! typeset -f rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  function rg {
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command rg ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
fi

  if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PID:-}" ] && [ -r "/proc/${CLAUDE_PID}/comm" ]; then
